name: American Uranium Limited
summary: American Uranium Limited, operating with its subsidiaries, explores for mineral properties across Wyoming and Utah in the United States. The company primarily targets uranium and vanadium deposits. Its principal asset is the wholly-owned Lo Herma In-Situ Recovery (ISR) uranium project, encompassing roughly 13,500 acres. This project includes both mineral lode claims and two state leases, situated in Converse County within Wyoming's Powder River Basin. Established in 2007, the company was formerly known as GTI Energy Ltd before officially rebranding to American Uranium Limited in August 2025. Its corporate base is located in West Perth, Australia.
